text:
Mostly diced tofu or chicken, with shaved parmesan, shredded carrot and red onion, in a metal mixing bowl. I'd put the food at roughly 250 g: about 180 g of tofu/chicken, 30 g of shaved cheese and 30 g of vegetables. If the cubes are chicken that comes to about 300 kcal, about 120 kcal from cheese and 15 kcal from vegetables, so roughly 435 kcal. I settled near 400 kcal as a compromise between tofu and chicken.
